citations.claim: The ComposioClient class manages authentication and API interactions with Composio's platform
Composio client is instantiated lazily only when needed to reduce startup overhead
_extract_tools function normalizes Composio's tool metadata into simplified format
list_tools method provides toolkit-specific tool discovery with error handling
search_tools method enables cross-toolkit text search with 20 result limit
execute method handles tool invocation with flexible argument passing and bypasses version checking
get_tool_schema provides runtime schema discovery for dynamic parameter validation
Factory function returns configured ComposioClient instance following centaur conventions
centaur_sdk provides secret management functionality for API key retrieval
Composio SDK is imported lazily for API interactions
Component depends on composio>=0.13.0 as its primary external dependency
COMPOSIO_API_KEY secret is configured for backend.composio.dev API authentication
Default user_id 'centaur' provides shared scope for connected accounts in deployment
Tool execution bypasses version checking for practical deployment scenarios
Search results are limited to first 20 items for performance
All API calls use structured error handling with warning-level logging
